{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows sustained positive sentiment (e.g., >0.50) and model overestimates prices.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if recent true outcomes show mean reversion after sharp spikes.",
    "Increase forecast lag by 1-2 days if sentiment history includes multiple consecutive positive values (e.g., 0.33+).",
    "Apply downward bias correction if model consistently overpredicts prices during low sentiment periods (e.g., sentiment < 0.00).",
    "Cap forecast growth after 3 consecutive days of upward sentiment to prevent overshoot.",
    "If true outcome is significantly lower than forecast (e.g., >10% gap), reduce forecast by 10-20% for next period.",
    "Use sentiment history to weight forecast adjustments: higher sentiment → higher adjustment magnitude."
  ]
}
